root: ^Meow, that food looks delicious...where did you get it?
^This is mine! You can’t have it!
^nom nom* These are my gifts that come from above!
^My gods send them for me and me only! *nom nom*.
^Calm down, I was just asking! Wait… did you say your gods? You really believe that?
^This is a coveted spot in this sea. Whoever controls this spot gets all the gifts. *nom nom*
^You’ve had this spot for a while, by the looks of it.
^But that stuff is not from any gods, just people throwing scrapes down here.
^gulp* Now go away, I’m waiting for more. This is the worst part…
^I have to eat scraps from behind the bins that are days old and nearly rotting.
^What’s a bin? Wait...you have never been given a gift from the gods?
^No. There is this girl, she sometimes feeds me nice things...she’s the only person that does.
^But she’s not a god. Just a kid.
^Do her gifts come from above? Nom.
^Well, I guess so…she is much taller than me.
^She’s not my god! But she is really important to me, I guess…
^I should go. I need to find something sharp.
^I can’t talk anymore, you’ll make me miss my next gift! *gasp* I can see one coming now! Leave!
